section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Differential
title: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Differential

content.description: Illustration showing installation of side bearing cap on differential carrier using a tool

content.text: Align the marks on the cap and carrier.

content.description: Illustration showing measurement of preload using a torque wrench on the differential

content.text: Using a torque wrench, measure the total preload.

content.value: In addition to drive pinion preload 4 – 6 kg-cm (3.5 – 5.2 in.-lb, 0.4 – 0.6 N·m)

content.description: Illustration showing inspection of ring gear and drive pinion tooth contact

content.text: 7. INSPECT TOOTH CONTACT BETWEEN RING GEAR AND DRIVE PINION

items: (a) Coat 3 or 4 teeth at three different positions on the ring gear with red lead.
(b) Hold the companion flange firmly and rotate the ring gear in both directions.

content.description: Diagram showing four types of tooth contact patterns: Heel Contact, Face Contact, Toe Contact, and Flank Contact, with arrows indicating adjustment directions for proper contact

content.text: Select an adjusting shim that will bring the drive pinion closer to the ring gear.
Select an adjusting shim that will shift the drive pinion away from the ring gear.
